rationale: Training-time quant-aware roundtrips were also re-casting tensors that are already preserved in float in the final artifact, especially the tied embedding and other keep-float tensors. This change keeps the late export-alignment pressure on tensors that will actually be int8-quantized, while deferring float-kept tensor roundtrips to the final exact export path. It is a compact export-alignment edit on top of the current recurrent-tail baseline, keeps the final evaluation unchanged, and avoids spending late-run updates on repeated fp16 churn for tensors that never face int8 error at score time.
title: Defer Float-Kept Quant-Aware Roundtrips
